A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AlignDistil and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Text comparison and visual inspection support matching the equations, tables and figures across versions.

before.justification: v2 reports original alignment evaluations, reward and extrapolation ablations, TL;DR results, and convergence experiments in Tables 1–4 and Figure 2.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3-8B evaluations in Table 5, including evaluations of externally sourced baseline checkpoints.

M1.justification: The contrastive DPO reward, token-adaptive logit extrapolation, and on-policy/off-policy objectives in Section 4 are unchanged. The larger models are additional experimental configurations of the existing method.

E1.justification: Section 6.3 adds UltraChat-200k as supervised instruction-tuning data for Qwen2.5-7B. UltraFeedback, TL;DR and the existing evaluation benchmarks remain; the larger-model evaluations use the already included AlpacaEval 2.0 benchmark.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the retained experiments. New Table 5 evaluates existing comparison methods—SFT, DPO, SimPO, TDPO1, TDPO2 and RTO—on additional model configurations. Methods absent from this new table remain in their original comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 6.3 substantially extends the evaluated model configurations from approximately 1.5B Qwen models to Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3-8B, adding a larger scale and another model family. It introduces Qwen instruction-model training and uses externally provided Llama SFT/DPO/SimPO checkpoints. Existing experiments and metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The reward ablation in Table 2, extrapolation sensitivity analysis in Table 3, and convergence comparison in Figure 2 are unchanged. Table 5 supplies additional benchmark comparisons without a separate ablation, robustness test or error analysis.

E5.justification: The new results follow the existing point-estimate reporting practice, without added run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The appendix judge correlations and convergence reporting are unchanged.

E6.justification: New Table 5 substantially extends the performance evidence to larger models and another family. On-policy AlignDistil achieves AlpacaEval length-controlled win rates of 31.32% versus TDPO1's 26.42% on Qwen2.5-7B, and 26.29% versus RTO's 17.00% on Llama3-8B. These are newly reported configurations, not improvements over corresponding v2 runs. Previously reported results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Theorem 1, the mathematical formulation in Sections 2–4, the proofs and derivations in Appendices A–B, and the convergence-comparison gradient formulas in Appendix E are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about RLHF–distillation equivalence, the two method components, alignment performance and faster convergence. The larger-model experiments add support without redefining these contributions.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and qualifications are unchanged. Section 6.3 reiterates effectiveness using additional results without a new explanatory analysis. The Limitations paragraph remains verbatim, still saying evaluation is limited to approximately 1.5B models, which now conflicts with Table 5.

D1.justification: Section 6.3 and Table 5 add the Qwen SFT data and recipe reference, identify the reused Llama SFT/DPO/SimPO checkpoints, and provide their repository link. Appendix C remains unchanged and does not specify extrapolation settings for the new 7B/8B models.

R1.justification: v3 adds Ding et al. (2023) for UltraChat and cites the already included Meng et al. (2024) for the new training/checkpoint provenance. Section 7 and the substantive positioning against prior research remain unchanged.

P1.justification: A short 'Results on Larger Models' subsection is inserted as Section 6.3. The TL;DR and convergence subsections become 6.4 and 6.5, with corresponding cross-reference updates. The surrounding prose and appendix structure are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds Table 5 with separate Qwen and Llama result blocks and moves the unchanged Figure 2 from the left to the right column on page 8. Subsequent text and references reflow. The original appendix judge table becomes Table 6 without changes to its contents.

improvement.justification: Section 6.3 and Table 5 partly address v2's explicitly acknowledged lack of larger-model validation, extending supporting evidence to 7B/8B models and the Llama family. The gain is limited to AlpacaEval, with incomplete model-specific settings and no uncertainty estimates. The unchanged 1.5B-only limitation also creates an inconsistency. The additional evidence nevertheless provides a modest net improvement.
